messages:
sam-partnerships: Heads up — drafting a pricing lift + step-down plan for the ACME private offer. Need quick thumbs on commit tiers, HW kicker, and renewal smoothing. Goal: in-market by end of Q2.

lina-finance: Numbers? target ARR and margin floor?

sam-partnerships: Target commit for initial offer: $250k ARR baseline. Thinking three tiers but open to push: 50k / 250k / 1M. Target blended discount ~15% off marketplace list. Need to keep gross margin >40%.

owen-sales: Field input: 50k / 250k / 1M => 8% / 15% / 22% feels doable. Renewal step-down: -3% Y2, -2% Y3. Add a 90-day ramp credit to reduce churn objections. :thumbsup:

tess-legal: Note: HW kicker (appliance credit) can’t be bundled into marketplace PO without separate SOW. Also need export control clause if partner ships appliances outside NA/EU. cc @raj-engineering

raj-engineering: FYI HW / appliance lead time ~4–6 weeks. Dedicated pool reservations required for guaranteed latency; if we promise burst capacity ops cost +12%. Call out SLA delta in the offer.

jenna-marketing: Marketplace listing -> ~7 business days after signature. For joint SI co-sell and press we need a 2-week runway. Prefer synced launch; suggest book partner announce slot M-1. @owen-sales do partners want pilot before public?

owen-sales: Recommend soft pilot with SI first, then public listing. Lowers churn risk and gives case studies.

sam-partnerships: Quick draft payload for ops/finance (for modeling):

```json
{
  "offer_name": "ACME-commit-Q2",
  "tiers": [
    {"commit": "50k", "discount": "8%"},
    {"commit": "250k", "discount": "15%"},
    {"commit": "1M", "discount": "22%"}
  ],
  "renewal_stepdown": ["-3%","-2%"],
  "hw_kicker": "appliance-10%-credit (separate SOW)",
  "ramp_credit": "90-day usage credit up to 20% of commit"
}
```

lina-finance: Can you add assumed CPI (cost per inference), avg token spend, and expected utilization? I’ll run margin sims on this.

raj-engineering: Also flag: if we expose dedicated endpoints we need to adjust per-token pricing + quota enforcement. Will list ops delta in a follow-up.

tess-legal: I’ll draft the appliance SOW outline + add export & data residency checks. ETA EOD Thursday.

jenna-marketing: Tentative announcement week: week of May 5. Lock dates by Apr 10 to hit comms and enable partner co-marketing assets.

sam-partnerships: Thanks — will iterate on pricing table and push a v2 by tomorrow. @lina-finance can you run sims? @jenna-marketing I’ll block tentative May 5 on the calendar. :rocket:
